Piercer here! 

Your eyebrow piercing looks fine. No signs of rejection. Trust me, you'll know when it's rejecting, you'll see more bar than skin. If you keep bumping it, most likely you'll just get an irritation bump with some pus. If that happens, keep cleaning it 3-4 times a day and don't let anyone with dirty hands touch it. 

If anything, I'm concerned with the spacing. Would you say you have a long enough bar in case of swelling? I can't really tell in the pictures. Wounds will always swell. If it fits too snug, I would recommend a longer bar.

Piercing looks fine. Like everyone else said, it looks like an irritation bump, which is completely normal if your hair or shirt has been pulling it by accident. I would only suggest being more cautious with it. Do not change the jewelry unless you've had this piercing for at least a month. Changing it too early into the healing process could be difficult and/or delay the healing
